summary: Completed testing of Witness Network and Panic Gesture features. All 23 backend API tests pass (100%). Fixed 1 bug during testing: datetime timezone handling in Panic Gesture trigger endpoint. Both frontend pages load correctly with all UI elements.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend uses old API endpoints (/api/advanced/witness/*) while new backend router provides /api/witness-network/*. Both work but are separate implementations.
integration_issues.note: Not a bug - both endpoint sets work. Old endpoints still functional.

frontend_tests_passed: Panic Gesture page loads at /panic-gesture with data-testid='panic-gesture-page'
Panic Gesture - Page title 'Panic Gesture' displayed
Panic Gesture - Panic enable toggle found (data-testid='panic-enable-toggle')
Panic Gesture - Gesture selection section with 4 presets (Shake, Volume, Power, Squeeze)
Panic Gesture - Sensitivity options (Low, Medium, High)
Panic Gesture - Test Your Gesture section with Start Test button
Panic Gesture - Manual Trigger button works (creates encounter)
Panic Gesture - When Triggered section with auto-action toggles
Witness Network page loads at /witness-network with data-testid='witness-network-page'
Witness Network - Page title 'Witness Network' displayed
Witness Network - Witness Mode toggle found (data-testid='witness-mode-toggle')
Witness Network - Stats cards (Encounters Witnessed, Recordings Submitted, Reputation Score)
Witness Network - How It Works section

bugs_fixed.issue: TypeError: can't subtract offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes in trigger_panic_recording
bugs_fixed.fix: Added timezone handling for MongoDB datetime values - check if triggered_at.tzinfo is None and add UTC timezone

critical_code_review_comments: Witness Network properly handles location sharing, witness alerts, and multi-angle recording coordination
Panic Gesture correctly implements gesture configuration, trigger with cooldown, and presets
All endpoints require authentication (return 403 for unauthenticated requests)
Panic Gesture trigger creates encounter in stealth mode with proper settings
seed_data_creation: Created test encounters via panic trigger during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two new safety features fully tested and working: Witness Network (proximity-based witness alerts, location sharing, multi-angle recording) and Panic Gesture (secret gesture detection for stealth recording). One bug fixed during testing (datetime timezone handling). Frontend pages load correctly. Note: WitnessNetworkPage.jsx uses old /api/advanced/witness/* endpoints which still work alongside new /api/witness-network/* endpoints.
